input_units.ang_vel: rad/s, body frame: x forward, y left, z up (gyroscope)
input_units.heading: [sin(yaw), cos(yaw)], yaw in rad from the start direction, positive = turned left (counterclockwise from above)
input_units.wheel_vel: rad/s, [left leg, right leg], positive = the direction that walks the robot forward
input_units.last_action: the policy's own previous output, [left, right]

outputs: [left, right] in about -1..1; target leg speed = output x max_leg_speed_rad_s, positive = forward
